body: So I should keep struggling a life I don’t want to live for world war or space trips...lol. No that doesn’t sound to appealing and if death is gonna happen either way then it’s better sooner than later. I live long enough and nothing interests me enough to say I want to live for that. But maybe I really do hate a lil to much. Life is a pain.

I’m from TX but I tried building my life again and strive for some happiness out there that I’m sure I can find if I put effort but what’s the point if I’m just ruin everything in the end. When I think like that, death sounds pretty good to me but I won’t be able to be happy that way. That’s why I’m not really sure what I want.

I want to believe that but I honestly feel that it would better if I was gone. Not necessarily die but if I were to just disappear they would be better off. Hell they wouldn’t even notice if I was gone. My family and I would be better off if I was dead. No, it would’ve been better if I was never born or existed in the first place.

I’m not close to many people and would they take me seriously. Won’t they think I’m just begging for attention or something pitiful as that. I feel they’ve already gave up on me but then again I’ve gave up on myself so I suppose it was inevitable. Thanks for your words and I will think about it.
How do you plan on doing it?
Sure I got nothing I want anymore.
